{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal grey (#3b3f46) with sharp shoulders and a single-breasted cut at hip length.
High-waisted tailored trousers in black viscose twill (#0d0e10), featuring a slim straight leg and a cropped length just above the ankle bone.
A fitted silk-blend blouse in cream white (#f5f5f0) with a classic pointed collar, short sleeves, and a straight hem falling at the waistline.
Leather ankle boots in polished black (#1a1a1a) with a low block heel and an almond-shaped toe.
Thin gold hoop earrings in 18k vermeil for subtle accent.

This outfit works because it balances the strict "smart" dress code requirements with the practical need to move comfortably through a crowded club environment. The dark neutral palette of charcoal, black, and cream aligns perfectly with her skin tones and hair color while maintaining a streamlined silhouette suitable for standing in a crowd. The structured jacket and tailored trousers provide a polished, classic look without sacrificing breathability or ease of movement for an evening in autumn. Finally, the low block heel offers stability on busy club floors, ensuring she can dance or walk for hours without discomfort."}
